mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may impair anastrozole metabolism and increase toxicity risk; both drugs have potential for hepatic effects.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and anastrozole efficacy/toxicity closely; ensure adequate hydration and consider liposomal amphotericin B formulation to minimize nephrotoxicity.
